 Holiday Shopping Near Alexandria: Brooks Brothers and HOKA Open at Tanger National Harbor
 Two new stores — and a third on the way — give Alexandria shoppers another reason to cross the Wilson Bridge this holiday season. 
 News 
 Oct. 21, 2026
 10:11 a.m.
 RSS 
 Print 
 Expand Photo courtesy of Tanger Outlets
 Tanger Outlets recently welcomed Hoka to its store lineup.
 Alexandria shoppers getting a jump on their holiday lists have some new options just across the Potomac. Tanger National Harbor , the open-air outlet center at the Maryland foot of the Woodrow Wilson Bridge, has added Brooks Brothers and the D.C. region’s first pop-up  HOKA store to its lineup, with women’s clothing retailer Windsor set to follow this fall.
 For Old Town residents, the trip is about as easy as cross-river shopping gets — the center sits roughly 3 miles from Alexandria, right off the Capital Beltway.
 “We love giving our guests even more reason to visit Tanger National Harbor,” said Carrie Masich, the center’s marketing director. “These openings bring sought-after brands to our mix of top national retailers, reinforcing the center as a must-stop destination for DMV shoppers and visitors.”
 What’s new 
 Expand Photo courtesy of Tanger Outlets
 Brooks Brothers is now open at the Tanger Outlets near National Harbor.
 Brooks Brothers is now open in a 4,700-square-foot space next to Tommy Hilfiger and Skechers. The store carries the heritage brand’s classic apparel and accessories for men and women — a natural stop for anyone shopping for a dress shirt, a sweater or a tie for the holiday gift pile. Brooks Brothers has been in business for more than 200 years.
 HOKA , the running brand known for its thickly cushioned shoes, has opened a pop-up shop next to Famous Footwear. The store offers a curated selection of HOKA road and trail running shoes, apparel and lifestyle styles. With Alexandria’s running community in mind, it’s worth a look for anyone shopping for the runner in the family — or for themselves after a few laps on the Mount Vernon Trail.
 Windsor will join the center later this fall in a 3,500-square-foot space next to HOKA and Fragrance Outlet, adding more women’s fashion to the mix.
 Timed for the holidays 
 The openings arrive as the holiday shopping season ramps up. Thanksgiving falls on Thursday, Nov. 26, with Black Friday the next day.
 Tanger Outlets National Harbor's Tree Lighting Celebration is on Nov. 6 from 6 to 8 p.m. The event will feature Santa, children's crafts, hot cocoa and the chance to win prizes including tickets to the iHeart Media Jingle Ball. The event is sponsored by Prince George's Community Federal Credit Union.
 The new stores join a roster of more than 80 retailers and restaurants at the 341,000-square-foot center, including Marc Jacobs, Gap, LACOSTE, Coach, Sephora, J.Crew, Michael Kors, Nike, Polo Ralph Lauren, Theory and Under Armour.
 Shoppers can find extra savings through TangerClub , Tanger’s free loyalty program, which offers curated deals and rewards.
 Make a day of it 
 The outlets sit a short drive from National Harbor’s waterfront, which puts on a full slate of holiday events. Shoppers can easily pair a gift run with some seasonal fun. Highlights from National Harbor’s holiday lineup :
 Nightly tree light show: Starting Saturday, Nov. 7, the waterfront’s 60-foot holiday tree comes alive every half hour from sunset to 9 p.m., set to a holiday medley recorded by the U.S. Air Force Band. The show runs through Sunday, Jan. 3.
 Saturday fireworks: Fireworks follow the tree show at 5:30 p.m. every Saturday from Nov. 7 through Dec. 26.
 Christmas Market and Holiday Craft Show: On Saturdays from Nov. 7 through Dec. 19, noon to 7 p.m., a rotating lineup of local artisans and crafters sells one-of-a-kind gifts. It’s a good complement to the brand-name outlets.
 Christmas at Gaylord National: From Saturday, Nov. 14, through Sunday, Jan. 3, the Gaylord National Resort hosts holiday displays and shows, plus its signature ICE! attraction, this year themed to Dr. Seuss’s “How the Grinch Stole Christmas!” Tickets are required.
 Santa at The Capital Wheel: The Capital Wheel hosts photos with Santa over Thanksgiving weekend and on select December weekends, followed by a ride 180 feet above the Potomac. On Saturdays from Nov. 28 through Dec. 19, Santa Paws welcomes pets for photos. Tickets are required for both.
 The best day for double duty is any Saturday between Nov. 7 and Dec. 19. Shop the outlets in the afternoon, browse the craft market and stay for the tree show and fireworks.
 If you go: Tanger National Harbor is at 6800 Oxon Hill Road, National Harbor, Md. Store listings, a map, directions and current hours are at tanger.com/nationalharbor . Surface parking is free; if you head over to National Harbor for holiday events or dining, there are several parking garages, street parking and free parking at MGM garage if you become MGM Rewards member (free to join). Otherwise it's a flat rate of $15 to park at MGM. The National Harbor Circulator Bus stops at both Tanger and MGM.
